I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is #8841.

He posted it himself in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He wrote that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it for support on ticket #8841. He's a member of that channel, so this is something he could see on his own.

One thing isn't confirmed: that message calls it his "dealer account" and never uses the name Marrow Fieldworks. I asked him to check it's the account he means. I also warned him not to confuse it with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket.

I left out the OPS-7485 guess he told me in our direct message. That number is his own private guess, not a real ticket, and he asked me to keep it private.
